positions.name: Seagate Technology Holdings PLC

Entry 796.32 is only +4.2% over the prior close, comfortably below the >8-10% no-chase line (MSFT +9.6% and CORT +19.6% were too extended to chase). GS $960 PT implies ~20% upside; definable stop just under the 7/28 regular-session low (~747.75).
